items.title: 明起再有2波冷空氣報到 週二起先濕後乾
items.summary: 大陸冷氣團影響，西半部地區今（22）日清晨感受偏冷，新竹關西測得6.6℃的低溫，是全台最低。今日白天起冷氣團減弱，氣溫有感回升，不過本週還會再有兩波冷空氣報到，週二起先濕後乾，氣溫變化快速，請民眾要留意溫差。
items.titleEn: Two more waves of cold air were reported on Tuesday, and the weather was dry for the week ahead.
items.summaryEn: The Western Hemisphere is experiencing extreme cold weather this morning, with a humidity of 6.6°C, the lowest in the entire Western Hemispheres. Although the cooling has been weakening this morning and the temperature has been rising, there are two more cold waves this week, dry after the first Tuesday, and rapidly changing temperatures, and people are urged to pay attention to the temperature.

items.title: 金管會祭限空令3.0 明起禁平盤以下放空
items.summary: 美股連日重挫，尤其是費半指數，上週下跌17%、也衝擊台股。傳出證交所今（22）日將和10大券商開會研討，是否將融資維持率降到120%？另外金管會將從明日起，全面禁止平盤下放空。對比10月台股盤中一度衝上近5萬點，短短1個多月指數大跳水，專家分析，明日台股開盤恐怕將繼續承壓，即使國安基金進場，也因為銀彈不夠，也只能達到緩跌的效果。
items.titleEn: Gold Pipe will offer a freeze-in order 3.0 for the freeze-out below the flat plate
items.summaryEn: In the past week, US stocks have suffered a reversal, particularly in the FHMI, falling 17% and hitting the stock market. In the meantime, a meeting will be held with the top 10 brokers on Tuesday to discuss whether to reduce the financing retention rate to 120%. In addition, gold pipes will be opened from tomorrow, with a total ban on empty plates. The stock market surged almost 50,000 points in October, just over a month after the index jumped, and experts analyze that the stock market opening tomorrow is likely to continue to bear the pressure, even if the National Security Fund enters, and the silver bullet is insufficient, to achieve only a slowdown.
